close_reason: Migrated SetError.extra from std::collections::HashMap to serde_json::Map in crate-jmap-types/src/methods.rs. Updated field type, skip_serializing_if predicate (HashMap::is_empty → serde_json::Map::is_empty), and constructor (HashMap::new() → serde_json::Map::new()). Added rustdoc note explaining the choice. No callers needed updates — every existing use (err.extra.get('serverRetryAfter') in test + jmap-chat-client's server_retry_after free fn) uses methods available on both types identically. Gates clean: cargo test --workspace, cargo clippy --workspace --tests -- -D warnings, cargo fmt --all -- --check. Now consistent with the 28 other extras fields added by JMAP-lbdy.1-.9, and serialized output is deterministic (insertion-ordered).
description:
Discovered while working JMAP-lbdy.1: `SetError.extra` in crate-jmap-types/src/methods.rs:181 currently uses `HashMap<String, serde_json::Value>`, but the workspace extras-preservation policy documented in AGENTS.md specifies `serde_json::Map<String, serde_json::Value>` as the canonical type.

`SetError.extra` predates the formal policy (it was added ad-hoc to support JMAP Chat's `serverRetryAfter` field). The bead description for JMAP-lbdy refers to it as the `MethodResponseError.extra precedent` even though that exact type name doesn't appear in code — the actual existing field is SetError.extra.

Why this matters:
- HashMap does NOT preserve insertion order; serialized output is non-deterministic across runs.
- serde_json::Map preserves insertion order with the preserve_order feature flag (which the workspace already enables in some crates).
- Round-trip equality tests can be flaky with HashMap if the test asserts byte-identical output for non-empty extras.
- Cookie-cutter consistency: all other extras fields added by JMAP-lbdy.1-.9 will use serde_json::Map, so SetError would be the sole drift point.

Scope: change the type of SetError.extra, update SetError::new() to construct serde_json::Map::new(), keep field shape attributes (#[serde(flatten, default, skip_serializing_if)]) identical. Update any callers that index extra with HashMap-specific semantics (Map<String, Value> has the same .get/.insert API). Verify existing test set_error_extension_fields_round_trip_via_extra still passes.

This is intentionally a separate small bead because it is a behavioral-stable type change that touches the public API of SetError and warrants its own commit.
title: Migrate SetError.extra from HashMap to serde_json::Map per workspace extras policy
